The '''Galactic Courts of Justice''', usually referred to just as the '''Courts Building''', '''Galactic Court''', '''Courts of Justice Building''' or '''Imperial Courts'''<ref name="E">{{WEGCite|story=Elusive (adventure)|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref> was a building on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that housed the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Supreme Court/Legends|Supreme Court]] as well as possibly the lesser [[Regional Court]]s. Under the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] the building housed the [[Court of Justice]].

==History==
The Courts of Justice Building was located in the [[Plains of Coruscant]].<ref name="cd">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

When the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] captured [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] the Supreme Court was replaced by the [[Court of Justice]]. The [[Trial of Tycho Celchu|trial]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] was tried there.<ref name="X-Wing: The Krytos Trap">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the building was the site of the [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Luke Skywalker|trial]] of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] within the [[Ninth Hall of Justice]].<ref name="Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref> The building also housed the [[High Court chamber]].<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
